Mega Floette applies only to Eternal Floette (Michael, 2026-10-29).

Each accepted game record matches its species, explicit form index, types, and six PokeAPI stats. Mega Starmie is the documented exception: direct ZA species 121/form 1 has Attack 140, rather than the CSV's 100.
All 33 Gigantamax weights are explicitly unknown: the repeated upstream 10000 value is not a measured 1,000 kg weight. Their displayed heights are lower bounds, rather than exact measurements.
Six Legendary Paradox flags retain the app's established category policy even though PokeAPI distinguishes them from conventional Legendary species.
Shape is a published species classification. These game personal tables contain no form-shape field. The 30 form shapes that differ from the species come from Bulbapedia, List of Pokémon by shape.
